fields.description: 8-byte save header magic, ASCII 'CHESSM02'. Verified in rev8-logical domain of baseline.sav. FUN_0800be8c reads 8 bytes at EEPROM offset 0 via FUN_0800bf74 and memcmps (FUN_08041df4) them against the expected magic; mismatch triggers a full reformat.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800be8c reads 8 bytes at EEPROM offset 0 (func_0x0800bf74(param_1,0,auStack_1c,8)) and compares via FUN_08041df4; baseline.sav rev8-logical bytes 0x00-0x07 are 43 48 45 53 53 4D 30 32 ('CHESSM02').
fields.name: header_magic

fields.description: First word of the 32-byte options block at EEPROM offset 8. FUN_0803c334 treats the block as valid only when this word equals its degenerate reference sum (0); baseline reads 0 and takes the defaults path.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803c298 reads 0x20 bytes at EEPROM offset 8 into the options buffer; FUN_0803c334 checks *psVar1 (first u16) against FUN_0803c300(psVar1,0)=0 and resets to defaults (FUN_0803b9fc/FUN_0803bc28) on mismatch.
fields.name: options_check_word

fields.description: Status byte of the options block (low byte of the second u16). FUN_0803c334 resets the block to defaults when (char)psVar1[1]==0; baseline is 0, i.e. unconfigured/default options.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803c334 condition (char)psVar1[1]=='\0' (options buffer byte 2, file offset 0x0A) selects the FUN_0803b9fc/FUN_0803bc28 defaults path; baseline.sav has 0x00 here.
fields.name: options_status_byte

fields.description: Remaining 29 bytes of the 32-byte options block (EEPROM offsets 0x0B-0x27): persisted configuration (sound/level/display style settings consumed by FUN_0803bc28). All zero in the baseline (default) capture.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803c298 persists 0x20 bytes at EEPROM offset 8; FUN_0803bc28 distributes options-buffer bytes (+3..+0x1c) into game state; baseline.sav rev8-logical bytes 0x0B-0x27 are all 0x00.
fields.name: options_payload

fields.description: First 4 data bytes of save slot 0 (EEPROM offset 0x28). Covered by the slot checksum: FUN_0803c324 byte-sums these 4 bytes, FUN_0803c174 stamps the sum, FUN_0803c1ac revalidates on load, FUN_0803c150 zeroes them on init. Mutable gameplay data word.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803c174 computes FUN_0803c324(iVar3) over slot base +0..+3 and stores at +4; FUN_0803c1ac invalidates the slot on mismatch; slot base = EEPROM offset (param_1*0x1d80000+0x280000)>>16 = 0x28 for slot 0, length 0x1d8 (FUN_0803c208/FUN_0803c250).
fields.name: slot0_header_data

fields.description: Slot 0 active flag (slot base +6). Load path FUN_0803bd48 reformats the slot (FUN_0803c150 + FUN_0803c174) when this byte is 0; FUN_0803c150 sets it to 1. Baseline is 1: freshly initialized but valid.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803bd48 checks *(char *)(slot_RAM+6)==0 then calls FUN_0803c150 (sets byte+6=1, byte+7=0) and FUN_0803c174 (re-stamps checksum); baseline.sav rev8-logical offset 0x2E is 0x01.
fields.name: slot0_valid_flag

fields.description: Slot 0 header pad byte (slot base +7), always cleared to 0 by the init path.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803c150 sets puVar1[7]=0 alongside the valid flag; baseline.sav rev8-logical offset 0x2F is 0x00.
fields.name: slot0_pad

fields.description: Remaining 464 bytes of the 472-byte slot 0 record (slot base +8): chess game state (board, clocks, move history) read/written wholesale with the slot. All zero in the baseline capture; trailing 8 bytes (0x1F8-0x1FF) read as erased 0xFF.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803c208/FUN_0803c250 transfer 0x1d8 bytes at EEPROM offset 0x28 for slot 0 (single slot: FUN_0803bd48 loop runs iVar3<1); baseline.sav rev8-logical bytes 0x30-0x1F7 are 0x00 with an erased 0xFF tail at 0x1F8-0x1FF.
fields.name: slot0_game_data
